scientific_question: Can a minimal state-aware action cue convert compact-v2 held-out over-navigation into reward, and does the effect differ between BASE and SUCCESS-SD-LORA?
hypothesis: If H1.7 identified an action-selection bottleneck, state-aware-v3 should reduce repeated next-page actions and increase product/buy-now transitions on the frozen H1.6 held-out panel; a prompt-only gain is not evidence of adapter learning.

controls.task_panel: identical frozen H1.6 held-out manifest; no evaluation task is used for training
controls.comparison: 2 model arms x 2 prompt contracts x 2 held-out partitions

task_panel.split: held-out-h1.6; frozen and never used for training

frozen_variables.runtime: pinned JDK/HF cache and one UUID-bound process per cell
frozen_variables.adapter_budget: BASE none; SUCCESS frozen H1 success adapter; no retraining

treatment_policy: search once when Search is admissible
on results pages prefer a plausible product link before Next >
use Next > only when no plausible product is shown, with at most two consecutive page advances
on product pages select required options, then click buy now
do not repeat an identical action unless no other admissible action exists

cell_design: 2 model arms x 2 prompt contracts x 2 held-out partitions = 8 cells; 4 tasks x 4 fresh seeds = 16 attempts per cell; 128 total
gpu_plan: one independent cell per authorized GPU UUID; no DDP, no duplicate deterministic cell

stop_branch.positive_transfer: state-aware-v3 produces >=2 qualified positives overall and improves SUCCESS versus its compact-v2 control: continue held-out learning analysis; D0 remains closed
stop_branch.prompt_only: state-aware-v3 improves BASE and SUCCESS similarly without selective SUCCESS gain: classify protocol rescue, no learning claim
stop_branch.diagnostic_only: next-page count falls but reward remains zero: action cue changes trajectory without task completion; do not open D0
stop_branch.null: no meaningful action or reward change: preserve negative evidence and stop prompt tweaking
stop_branch.runtime_failure: exclude invalid cells and open a separate repair group

claim_boundary: New prompt-intervention test on a frozen held-out panel; no benchmark claim, no broad generalization claim, no D0 opening without confirmation, and no SEED comparison.

result.binding: 8/8 UUID-bound cells passed; final compute apps empty
result.cell_result: state-aware-v3 SUCCESS partition A 4/16 qualified positives; all other cells 0/16
result.positive_task: goal 3396 on all four state-aware-v3 SUCCESS A seeds; each trace search -> product -> buy now
result.classification: selective state-aware held-out rescue with task heterogeneity; fresh-seed confirmation required before D0
